AI TECHNOLOGY

Data, method, evidence and review.

An acquisition file can include hundreds of scanned pages and several versions of a survey. The AI must read the pages, match parcel references and compare conflicting details across the file.

01 / PLANNED MODEL PATH

Document layout extraction

Read supplied page text, tables and document references with retained page context.

How to evaluate it +

Check OCR errors and references against representative title and survey documents.

02 / PLANNED MODEL PATH

Parcel and version matching

Find related references and compare dates, areas and versions.

How to evaluate it +

Measure incorrect matches and conflicts that require professional resolution.

03 / PLANNED MODEL PATH

Cited review generation

Use hybrid retrieval and structured language output to draft precise questions.

How to evaluate it +

Reject unsupported claims and evaluate quotation accuracy and missing evidence.

COMPUTE CHOICE

Use Document Intelligence for extraction and AI Search for indexed retrieval. Azure OpenAI performs managed model inference; that does not require claiming a self-managed GPU cluster. Version and cache unchanged pages before processing another review.

Architecture and evaluation plan. The candidate sector models require implementation and validation.
